_readme: Two regulars at the concession stand talking about people they have never met. Each beat is an opener and a set of possible replies — the second speaker picks one. {top} = the best player alive, {riser} = a name on the way up, {char} = a character, {days} = days until EVO. Nobody's stats move; this is pure texture.

world.open: Did you see {top} at that invitational? Nobody is touching them right now.
replies: I refuse to believe a human being plays like that.
One day somebody from here beats them. Calling it.
They drop one set a year and it makes the news.

world.open: {riser} keeps winning. Like, keeps winning winning.
replies: Ranked players are ducking them already.
I watched three of their sets and learned nothing. Too fast.
Give it a year and they're top eight, watch.
You are describing the best player alive.
Say that louder so everyone can hear you be wrong.
Okay but have you SEEN their {char}? Actually unfair.

world.open: If you could take one set off anyone in the top eight, who?
replies: {top}. Straight to the final boss.
{riser}, purely so they'd remember my name.
None of them. I'd like to keep my dignity.

evo.open: {days} days to EVO. I have opinions and nobody asked.
replies: {top} three-peats. Ask me nothing further.
Somebody out of pools nobody's heard of makes top eight. Happens every year.
I'm calling an upset in the finals. I can feel it.

evo.open: EVO pools drop soon. {top} versus literally anyone, I'm watching.
replies: I'd sell an organ to be there live.
The whole planet watches one weekend a year and it's this one.
Imagine one of ours on that stage. Just imagine it for a second.

evo.open: Who wins EVO this year — {top} or {riser}?
replies: {top}. Boring answer, correct answer.
{riser}. The torch gets passed this year.
Neither. Chaos wins. Chaos always wins eventually.
